about: Sanctuary Open's dialogue cuts (the writer's edits that need the conversations cut up). op: end = the conversation stops after node; jump = after node comes to; clip = keep sentences keep= of the line (1-based, cut at its own pauses by tools/python/VoiceSplice/dlgcut.py, checked by whisper); mute = silent.
